06535 Parnak {par-nak'}

字源不明; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Parnach 1; 1

帕納 = "細緻的"
1) 西布倫支派的首領以利撒番的父親, 以利撒番被選出來協助在各支派間分配應許之地
   (#民 34:25|)

06535 Parnak {par-nak'}

of uncertain derivation;; n pr m

AV - Parnach 1; 1

Parnach = "delicate"
1) father of Elizaphan, prince of the tribe of Zebulun chosen to help
   apportion the promised land between the tribes
